<!--
keep it short. name roles, not people: say "the human", "builder".
no home paths, machine names, addresses or emails: pr_text scans this
text on every post and edit, and the edit history keeps each revision.
-->

## Brief

What this changes and why, in two or three lines. Link the card or issue.

## Claims

Each claim is one checkable sentence with its evidence. The validator
measures these directly.

- **Claim 1**: ... - *Evidence*: `path/to/file.py:10-24`, `command` -> result

## Evidence

Commands run, their results, and where any logs or outputs live.

## Done check

The acceptance check from the brief, and its result on this head.

## Risks

What could break, who else it touches, and what is not done (by design).

## Changelog

One line for the release notes, or "none".
